decisions.statement: The cursor is kept beside the watcher log rather than in the game folder.
A cursor file that is not there reads as nothing carried up yet.
A cursor file that is there and reads as no counts by signature refuses the error import.
A cursor is never partly read.
A refusal names the cursor file it read.
A run that refuses leaves the cursor file as it was.
Saving makes the log directory where the directory is absent.

definition: the count last carried up for each game error, kept between runs of the watcher
